note: Zoom on the relief model table under the arched window of the B25 hall (R_world_01): the French countryside in miniature, seen from slightly above. Feminine LEFT: camper with a frying pan by his tent and two cows (campagne); painter on a stepladder colouring a sunlit patch of hills (région); white van racing through the lavender (province); walled old city with a knight and spyglass on the ramparts (cité); a little band of musicians playing at the dead end of the street of look-alike suburb houses (banlieue). Masculine RIGHT: church steeple and two lazing sheep on the green (village); hiker paying the bearded sage on the hilltop viewpoint (paysage); terrier guarding its fenced hill (territoire). No painted exit: the strip Back returns to the hall. Sign carved on the table edge.
